1.0.0.description:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/GBFound/BlenderArchipelago#installation).

- Data is saved in the blend file to make closing and reopening the file more convenient
- Materials now must be unlocked before Vertex Paint Mode, Texture Paint Mode, and Grease Pencil Modes
- New Items:
    - Geometry Nodes
    - Compositor
    - Filler: Full Arsenal (Removes all tool restrictions for a limited time, as if every tool was unlocked)
    - Trap: Despair ("Destroys" the object being worked on)
- New Options:
    - Progressive Render Width Count
    - Progressive Render Height Count
    - Check Count
    - Trap Filler Percent
    - Full Arsenal Duration
    - Deathlink
- Panel:
    - Added deathlink toggle in panel
    - Archipelago messages appear in panel
    - Improve panel UI in general
- Bug Fixes:
    - Fixed failure to connect to localhost
    - Fixed adjusting last operation causing a deathlink
    - Include websockets with the addon

- Lower default option values for trap count and full arsenal duration
